import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced by the # escaped headline and text respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Safely format and return a blog entry as an HTML string. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. User supplied. text : str The full body content of the blog post. User supplied. Returns ------- str An HTML string ready for inclusion in a webpage, with all user input properly escaped to prevent XSS attacks. Raises ------ ValueError If either headline or text is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(text, str): raise ValueError("headline and text must be strings") # Escape user input to neutralise any embedded HTML/JS safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Insert the escaped values into the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_text) return formatted_post
